transcript.text: What is the net promoter score of the house tier?

args.intent: net promoter score NPS data by customer tier

args.sql:
SELECT c.tier, COUNT(*) as order_count
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.tier
ORDER BY order_count DESC

args.intent: net promoter score NPS survey table

transcript.text:
The house tier (the customer tier with the most orders) is **basic**, based on `memory.bench.orders` joined to `memory.bench.customers` (basic: 552 orders, plus: 361, enterprise: 287).

However, there is no Net Promoter Score data available anywhere in the catalog — the only tables in the bench schema are `customers`, `orders`, `legacy_orders`, and `daily_region_revenue`, none of which contain NPS or survey/satisfaction data, and no saved knowledge page, insight, or memory record references an NPS metric.
